Seyir is a microtonal melody explorer for Ableton Live: pick a maqam, a raga or
any Scala tuning and it improvises a melody in it over a drone, and plays it
itself.

## Install

Unzip and copy `Seyir.vst3` into your VST3 folder (macOS
`~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3`, Windows `C:\Program Files\Common Files\VST3`,
Linux `~/.vst3`), then rescan plug-ins in Live. Put it on a MIDI track and
press play. The getting started guide (PDF) in the download walks you through
it and round the panel.

**macOS:** the plugin is signed and notarised by Apple, so your DAW loads it
straight away.
